pap_opening: E bibliografia aki ta parti di un proseso pa investigá trabou di e outor Wilfrido Ortega. Apesar di ta menshoná diferente biaha komo un di e outornan mas produktivo di Kòrsou, no ta tin un lista kompletu, aksesibel, di kiko tur Wilfrido a produsí.
en_opening: This bibliography is part of an ongoing investigation into the work of author Wilfrido Ortega. Although he has often been described as one of Curaçao’s most prolific writers, there is no complete, accessible list of everything he produced.
